```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
tidyverse_packages()

read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")

penguins <- read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")
```

# Importing with readr


```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(x = bill_len,
                     y = bill_dep,
                     colour = body_mass,
                     shape = species)) +
    labs(title = "Bill length and depth in penguins",
       x = "Bill length (mm)",
       y = "Bill depth (mm)",
       shape = "Species",
       colour = "Body Mass") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = 1.0)
```


# Generating some example data and generate a Heatmap


```{r}
set.seed(0982)
month_data <- tibble(
  date = seq(as.Date("2024-12-01"), 
              as.Date("2024-12-31"), 
              by = "day"),
  count = sample(1:20, 31, replace = TRUE)  # Random counts per day
) |>
  mutate(
    wday = wday(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),  # Day of the week (Sun-Sat)
    week = (day(date) - 1) %/% 7 + 1  # Week number (1 to 5)
  )

month_data |> head()  
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = month_data,
       mapping = aes(x = wday, 
                      y = week, 
                      fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_classic() + #removes background grid-lines
  labs(title = "Productivity December 2024",
       x = "Week Days",
       y = "Weeks",
       fill = "Count")
```


# Exploratory Analysis

```{r}
parfumo_data_clean <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-12-10/parfumo_data_clean.csv')

parfumo_data_clean |> glimpse()
parfumo_data_clean |> summarise()
parfumo_data_clean |> colnames()

parfumo_data_clean |> 
  group_by(Brand) |> 
  summarize(avg_Rating = mean(Rating_Value, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  arrange(desc(avg_Rating)) |> 
  head()

parfumo_data_clean |> summary()
```
